title: Social Theory Model Builder
description: A single-page web application that guides students from a population, an outcome, and one or more theories to stated propositions with page numbers, defined concepts, an editable conceptual figure, hypotheses or propositions, and paper-ready notes for theoretical papers. Live at https://social-theory-model-builder.netlify.app
